title: CppCon 2019: Matt Godbolt “Compiler Explorer: Behind The Scenes”
summary: Matt Godbolt tells the story of Compiler Explorer, from a hacky basement server to a cloud-scaled service handling tens of thousands of daily requests. He also shows its features and how it is built.
why: Recommended as the source on how Compiler Explorer began and for its lesser-known features like the machine code analyzer.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: a cool feature he presented is the integrated LLVM Machine Code Analyser tool
